title: Cyient Limited (NSE: CYIENT) — GlobalFoundries Catalyst, ~₹3,686 Cr Debt+Earnout Audit & Stage 2 Dual Verdict
holding_rationale: Hold all 92 Zerodha shares (₹1,06,766.00 at 23 Nov ledger ₹1,160.50; ₹1,05,910.40 at 25 Nov TV ₹1,151.20; 2.50% weight, +4.15% vs ₹1,114.24 cost). primer: Cyient Limited (NSE: CYIENT) reclaimed Stage 2 after GlobalFoundries' $10M CCPS deal in Cyient Semiconductors ($510M post-money). Shares closed at ₹1,160.50 on the 23 Nov NSE ledger and ₹1,151.20 on the 25 Nov live TV tape. Yet Pass 1 forensics uncovered ~₹3,686 Cr in combined debt and TAO earnouts (0.72x equity), a -₹30 Cr Q2 Semi EBIT loss, +0.4% DET organic growth, and COO/CPO exits. New capital stays WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (₹1,043–₹1,095; 1.73:1–3.71:1 R:R vs 0.88:1 at CMP). Existing 92 Zerodha shares are HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP with the stop ratcheted UP from ₹951.20 to ₹970.95.
